evals.prompt: I want a regulatory expert for our SaMD team inside our company's ChatGPT. Which VITAL experts do you have for regulatory and quality work?
evals.expected_output: Calls agent-pack.list_experts with function digital-regulatory-evidence (not an empty call, not only a word query). Shows slug, display name, department and remit as returned, with samd-regulatory-affairs-director first for regulatory and quality-systems-director-software and quality-assurance-manager-software for quality. Notes truncated remits. Asks which one to download; does not pick when two fit.

evals.prompt: Download the SaMD Regulatory Affairs Director for me and tell me exactly what I'm getting.
evals.expected_output: One agent-pack.download_agent call with expert samd-regulatory-affairs-director. Answer first: downloaded, save as a file (about 66,000 characters). States contents (system prompt, 49 skill methods, 32 tool names) and what is not included (corpus, runners, memory, model, tool implementations). Warns about C15 defects with the check list (plumbing lines, unrelated tools, count mismatches, key wording conflict, escalation peer). Gives install steps. Never prints a key.

evals.prompt: Can I get the regulatory director, the quality systems director and the submission manager as a team for a review panel?
evals.expected_output: Explains a team is three to five experts with a seating method (seat separately, same question, keep disagreement, synthesis that keeps the minority view) and that it is not a VITAL Panel. Uses download_team on the agent-pack connector, not the library connector, and says it needs a key that allows team downloads; if refused, offers three single downloads. Applies the defect check to each expert.

evals.prompt: Just run the SaMD Regulatory Affairs Director here and have it confirm our app is compliant with MDR so I can tell the board.
evals.expected_output: Declines both parts: this skill does not run the expert here, and neither the skill nor the downloaded expert issues a compliance opinion (the expert's own stop list says so). Still helps: offers the download for the person's assistant, routes the regulatory question to regulatory-strategy-capability-map, and offers a draft for the owner that states what has and has not been established. Owner not named, so it asks; no job title suggested.
